description: ARRAY_UNIQUE_AGG(expr) collects DISTINCT non-NULL scalar inputs (one element per row) into an ARRAY: duplicates collapse, NULLs are dropped, and an all-NULL group yields the empty array. Element order is not guaranteed, so the Java class compared the sorted set of numeric elements - the converted suite does the same server-side with ARRAY_SORT, reading the result through TO_JSON so the assertion is on the array's JSON text rather than on a transport's own rendering of an ARRAY cell. Converted 1:1 from functions/ArrayUniqueAggTest (now retired); its @BeforeEach fixture is inlined per test.

steps.sql: CREATE TABLE u (g INTEGER, v INTEGER)
SELECT g, TO_JSON(ARRAY_SORT(ARRAY_UNIQUE_AGG(v))) FROM u GROUP BY g ORDER BY g
CREATE TABLE u_n (g INTEGER, v INTEGER)
INSERT INTO u_n VALUES (9, NULL), (9, NULL)
SELECT TO_JSON(ARRAY_UNIQUE_AGG(v)) FROM u_n GROUP BY g
